markers.name: T1 - Ronda
markers.gear: 6th throughout, no shift (134.5 km/h is 12,959 rpm in 6th)

markers.name: T2 - Lama
markers.gear: 6th, no shift (129.0 km/h is 12,429 rpm in 6th)

markers.name: T3 - Il Pozzo
markers.gear: 6th to 1st on the brakes, 1st at the apex, 1st-2nd-3rd-4th-5th up La Rampa

markers.name: T4 - Il Ciglione
markers.gear: 5th down to 4th on the lift; 4th at the apex, 12,940 rpm

markers.name: T5 - Vigna
markers.gear: 5th down to 4th; 4th at the apex, 12,416 rpm

markers.name: T6 - Forbice A
markers.gear: 5th down to 4th; 4th through both halves, 13,068 rpm at the apex

markers.name: T7 - Forbice B
markers.gear: 4th throughout, 13,068 rpm at the apex - the whole esse lives inside one gear

markers.name: T8 - Uscita
markers.gear: 6th down to 5th; 5th through both arcs at 12,384 rpm, 6th on the run to the line
